top_events.title: Largest attack on Moscow sees Ukraine fire hundreds of drones, mayor says
top_events.label: Ukraine fires 450 drones at Moscow region
top_events.summary: Ukraine launched its largest drone attack on Moscow, with 450 drones downed and two killed. Represents significant escalation in the war on Poland's eastern border.

top_events.title: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
top_events.label: German CDU suffers disaster in state elections
top_events.summary: Merz's CDU suffered damaging losses in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. Weakens potential future EU leadership and stability of Poland's key western partner.

top_events.summary: Trump claims permanent US security control over Greenland after Denmark deal. Continues NATO alliance shifts with indirect implications for European security architecture.
